instruction: In one Part Design body, create a cylindrical blank with radius 22 mm and height 36 mm, centered on the global Z axis, with its bottom face on the XY plane at Z = 0 and its top face at Z = 36. Create the subtractive-helix cutter profile as a new circle sketch on the XZ plane, facing along the Y direction, with radius 2 mm and center at global coordinates (22, 0, 0) so the circle straddles the cylinder side wall. Use Part Design Subtractive Helix around the global Z axis with 3 turns, 12 mm pitch, height 36 mm, and 0 degree cone angle to cut one helical groove around the cylinder. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
